theme: Task group variants and result ordering

terms.definition: A task group whose child tasks can throw, and which passes on the first error.
terms.example: Use a throwing task group when a child task can fail.

terms.definition: A task group that throws away each child's result as it finishes, made for tasks that return nothing.
terms.example: A discarding task group keeps memory small for log tasks.

terms.definition: The order in which a task group hands back child results, which is when they finish, not when you added them.
terms.example: Never depend on the result order of a group.

video.description:
Learn to explain how to talk about task groups that throw, task groups that discard results and the order results arrive in: Throwing Task Group, Discarding Task Group & Result Order, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Throwing Task Group - A task group whose child tasks can throw, and which passes on the first error.
Discarding Task Group - A task group that throws away each child's result as it finishes, made for tasks that return nothing.
Result Order - The order in which a task group hands back child results, which is when they finish, not when you added them.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Throwing Task Group, Discarding Task Group and Result Order in English?

dialogue.title: Why are my results out of order?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my results come out in a different order than I added the tasks.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is the result order. Child tasks finish at different times, and the group gives results as they finish.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I keep the original order?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Return `n` with each result, then sort them. Do not trust the result order.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: OK. One of my tasks can also throw an error.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then switch to a throwing task group. The first error cancels the other children.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I also have a group that only prints logs. Each task returns nothing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a discarding task group. It throws away each result when the task finishes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the result order does not matter there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. You just wait for every task.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Great. A throwing task group for loads, and a discarding task group for logs.
Use a throwing task group when a child task can fail.
